name: Kinetics — spring physics animation library by kinetics.colorion.co
description: A near-black catalogue of 111 spring-driven interface effects organised as three dense demo grids — Interaction & Input, Feedback & State, Surface & Motion — each introduced by a letterspaced uppercase header with a monospace counter. The hero buys contrast through sparseness: an animated spring waveform, a huge condensed uppercase headline where one word flips to saturated orange, and a floating card previewing the CSS/React/AI-prompt handoff. Below, every card repeats one disciplined template (demo stage → monospace physics parameters → name → one-line description → View code link), so the single orange accent and the monospace meta layer carry the whole identity.
